verdict.rationale: Docs mention automating creation of Jira tickets during incidents and retrospectives capturing 'Lessons Learned,' implying some follow-up action creation and sync, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'follow-up items' feature with completion tracking or dashboards to ensure items are closed out. missing for 10: dedicated follow-up/action-item tracking feature, explicit Jira two-way sync/status updates, evidence of completion tracking or reporting on open follow-ups.
